# Abdullah Al Salma (عبدالله آل سلمى)

> Abdullah Al Salma is a Researcher & Inventor at Aramco's Research & Development Center in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. He is a named inventor on 13 US patent filings — 5 granted, 5 published, 3 filed — covering chemical processing, robotics, pipeline systems, and coating technologies.

Also written as: Abdullah M. Al Salma, Abdullah AlSalma, Abdullah Bin Salma, عبدالله محمد آل سلمى, عبدالله بن سلمى, آل سلمى.

## Role

- Researcher & Inventor, Research & Development Center, Aramco (Dhahran, Saudi Arabia)

## Education

- Bachelor of Engineering in Chemical & Industrial Process Engineering — Bahrain Polytechnic
- Associate's Degree in Chemical Production — Technical and Vocational Training Corporation (TVTC)
